name: The Estuary · Body influence

native_all_body_baseline.scope: One full native all-body baseline; identical runtime source to production, exact RC1 material and PNG bytes.

production.resource_scope: Parent samples every two seconds; peaks are observed samples, not continuous maxima.

resources.scope: Two bounded batches of native 2048, three-pigment, single-view films

browser_review.scope: All ten seeds checked for image/preview loading; representative real videos exercised through complete playback, replay, shared seeking and selection changes. All70 film URLs checked for range access; every new film has complete decode evidence.

runtime_identity_hash_format: SHA-256 of common.encoded(plan.runtime): sorted JSON, indent=2, final newline.
study_scope: Ten RC1 seeds and all six proper nonempty body subsets. Complete source trajectories, projection, starting paint layout, initial pixels, palette, pigment amounts, other simulation controls, lighting, camera and full film timeline are held fixed. Direct material forcing and adaptive source-travel criteria use active bodies; pair forcing and eligible encounter selection require both endpoints active. Eligible events are selected before ranking and refractory competition. Strengths are not renormalized. Reduced final material identities are expected to differ.

validation.event_verification: Eligible encounter schedules independently regenerated from each archived complete source and canonical active-body subset.
validation.media_verification: Complete decode receipts plus independently checked movie, frame, source and artifact associations for every case.

poster_visual_review.notes: Minor native-scale contour stepping/ribbing remains in some images; no general aesthetic improvement claimed. Final posters inspected; this is not certification of every movie frame.
